title: POST /books over-validates: year and isbn also required
evidence: src/index.ts:22 returns 400 when year or isbn is missing, though TASK.md/R9 only require title and author
suggestion: Make year/isbn optional (or document them as required) to match the spec's 'title and author are required'

title: Each query opens and closes its own sqlite3 connection
evidence: src/db.ts:7 getDb() creates a new Database per call in run/all/get/runWithLastInsertId
suggestion: Reuse a single shared connection to avoid open/close churn under load
